pending_items.title: Kushner says Israel is becoming a 'pariah' as his Board of Peace plans stall
pending_items.content:
Israel is on track to become a “global pariah” over its genocide in the Gaza Strip, Jared Kushner, US President Donald Trump’s son-in-law and diplomatic envoy, said in an interview released on Monday.

“Israel could rise from the tragedy of October 7, [and] be much more secure and much more integrated into the world, or they can go on the current trajectory, which is to trend toward global-pariah status,” Kushner said in an interview with New York Magazine.

The remarks are notable given Kushner’s longtime advocacy for Israel and efforts to put it at the centre of a new regional security architecture in the Middle East.

Kushner is a longtime family friend of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and created the controversial Board of Peace which was supposed to oversee Gaza’s reconstruction.
